verdict.rationale: CDP provides building blocks for autonomous agent automation — webhooks for real-time event triggers, an Agentic Wallet CLI that gives AI agents standalone wallets to hold/spend/trade stablecoins, and x402 skills for agents to monetize or pay for services programmatically — which together enable background, event-driven agent workflows. However there's no explicit scheduler/cron or persistent background-runtime documentation showing agents running continuously unattended, only reactive primitives (webhooks + wallet skills). Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/always-on runtime evidence, independent/hands-on confirmation of autonomous background operation, monitoring/alerting for automation health.
